scientific_integrity.claim: Complete adjacency characteristic polynomial and inertia of the simple commuting graph induced by rank-one partial bijections.
limitations: Rank one and n at least 3 only.
Historical priority may be affected by broader graph association schemes.
scientific_integrity.proof_basis: Explicit composition and adjacency kernel; transpose invariant splitting; skew row-sum quotient; symmetric row/diagonal quotient; full-row-rank unsigned incidence of complete graph.
scientific_integrity.verification: Exact independent compositions and characteristic polynomials for sizes 3 through 6, not infinite certification.

title: Complete adjacency spectrum and nullity onset for commuting rank-one partial bijections
